# Wix

> > Wix is an AI-powered website builder platform offering drag-and-drop design tools, 2000+ templates, eCommerce capabilities, and integrated business solutions for creating professional websites without coding.

Wix provides an all-in-one platform for building websites, managing online stores, accepting payments, and running business operations. The platform combines AI-assisted design with traditional drag-and-drop editing, serving entrepreneurs, creative professionals, restaurants, and enterprises.

## Key Topics

- AI Website Builder
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- Website Templates
- eCommerce Platform
- Payment Processing
- Domain Registration
- Web Hosting
- CRM Tools
- Email Marketing
- Analytics
- SEO Tools
- Appointment Scheduling
- Website Security
- Mobile App
- Wix Studio

## Core Website Building

- [Website Builder - Create a Free Website In Minutes](https://www.wix.com): Wix homepage: Free website builder with 2000+ templates and AI tools
- [AI Website Builder - Create A Website In Minutes](https://www.wix.com/ai-website-builder): Wix AI website builder for fast, intuitive site creation and design
- [Website Design - Design Websites That Set You Apart](https://www.wix.com/website/design): Wix website design solution with AI tools and drag-and-drop editor
- [Website Templates - 2000+ Free HTML5 Website Templates](https://www.wix.com/website/templates): Browse 2000+ free HTML5 templates for various industries and use cases
- [Explore Wix Features](https://www.wix.com/features/main): Wix features overview: design tools, mobile editor, VideoBox, Photo Studio

## Business Solutions

- [eCommerce Website Builder: Build An eCommerce Site](https://www.wix.com/ecommerce/website): Wix eCommerce platform for creating customizable online stores
- [Appointment Scheduling Software - Take Bookings Online](https://www.wix.com/scheduling-software): Wix scheduling software for appointment booking and payment management
- [Free Restaurant Website Builder](https://www.wix.com/restaurant/website): Wix restaurant builder with online ordering and POS integration
- [Free CRM Software For Your Business](https://www.wix.com/features/crm): Wix CRM with lead capture, automation, live chat and contact management
- [Free Email Marketing Tool](https://www.wix.com/features/email-marketing): Wix email marketing tool with campaigns, templates and automation

## Specialized Builders

- [Create a Blog That Inspires - Free Blog Maker](https://www.wix.com/start/blog): Wix blog maker with SEO tools and marketing features for content creators
- [Portfolio Website Maker - Create a Free Online Portfolio](https://www.wix.com/portfolio-website): Wix portfolio builder for creative professionals to showcase work

## Infrastructure & Management

- [Accept Payments Online, In Person and On The Go - Wix Payments](https://www.wix.com/payments): Wix Payments gateway supporting credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- [Buy a Domain Name - Easy Domain Registration & Setup](https://www.wix.com/domains): Wix domain registration with SSL, DNSSEC and business email support
- [Free Web Hosting - Reliable Website Hosting](https://www.wix.com/free/web-hosting): Wix free web hosting with CDN, Google Cloud and AWS infrastructure
- [Website Security - Built-in Protection for Your Site](https://www.wix.com/website-security): Wix enterprise-grade security with PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR compliance

## Analytics & Growth Tools

- [Website Analytics - Track Your Site's Performance](https://www.wix.com/manage/analytics): Wix Analytics for tracking traffic, visitor behavior and revenue metrics
- [Discover a Suite of Advanced SEO and Marketing Tools](https://www.wix.com/seo): Wix SEO tools with local SEO, keyword research and Semrush integration

## Enterprise & Mobile

- [Wix Studio - The Web Platform Built for Agencies and Enterprises](https://www.wix.com/studio): Wix Studio platform for agencies and enterprises with CSS and animations
- [Wix App - Manage Your Site From Mobile](https://www.wix.com/mobile/wix-app): Wix mobile app for managing sites, bookings, payments on the go
